capabilities: Import Hevy workouts as one note per workout
Write workout frontmatter queryable with Dataview
Sync only new workouts or re-import and overwrite all
Configure API key, target folder, and bodyweight for volume calculation
disambiguation: Not device or vault syncing; 'sync' here means a one-way import of workouts from the Hevy service into notes.
extras: Notes are named by Hevy workout id, so renamed notes are re-imported on the next sync; sets without a logged weight display as nullkg.
problem: Obsidian has no way to pull workout history from the Hevy app into queryable vault notes.

relations.evidence: one note per workout, with frontmatter you can query with Dataview

summary: Imports Hevy workout-tracking data into Obsidian as one note per workout with Dataview-queryable frontmatter.
